title: permission.resolved
description: The terminal state of a permission interaction. resolution: expired is emitted by Conductor, not by a human.

actor.description: Who authorised this resolution. Exactly one of two shapes, never a blend of them and never a partial one: an attested human, which a saas-attested envelope carries because a service acted for a person it authenticated; or a signing key, which is the only identity a deployment with no user directory has. The union exists here and not on the shared actor definition because permission.resolved is the record a reviewer reads to answer who allowed this, and it is the one event a Conductor with no user directory must still be able to answer it for. Absent when nobody authorised anything - resolution: expired is the deadline speaking, not a person.
